name: WarCommand
desc:
A classic RTS (real time strategy) experience on Roblox. Build a base, command an army, and prepare for war!
Destroy all enemy bases to win.


-- PC -- 
Left Click: Select Unit
Right Click: Move Unit / Attack Unit
-- Mobile --
Tap: Select Unit 
Hold: Move Unit / Attack Unit

This game is new and still in development. Feel free to DM me any issues, bugs, or suggestions!
